question: Does one-way growth (new sites, never fewer) with a steady written share count as the arrow of time, or must the number of lasting records keep rising?
effect: Arrow card finish line = one-way growth of sites/record-events; a steady written share suffices (consistent with PD-36/37). Lasting-record rise is not required. Evidence: B20 WW2 check (claude2/work/c3_resume_v001/batch20_principal_readings_v001/checks/B20_CHECK_WW2_V001.json sha256 778611ff1efdbf55bbbdbcc4623bbc996140eefccde4c1c148aca400085e4f80): steady share appears natively, two-way; growth is one-way.
